intent: A frozen highland under old snow: blue-grey snow, a rimed black pine wood over the hill-folk's runestone rings, barrow mounds and a broken hill-fort tower, an ice sheet in every hollow and a thin ice-blue mist threading low between the trunks, reading from the high camera as dark pines and grey stone over pale snow with one cold green-blue accent.
requests: A conifer/pine sculpt kind: the wood's black pines are tree sculpts, since only a bare-branched tree kind exists and a new kind is code.
A way to place the frozen lake as a named landmark: the ice sheet only appears in terrace hollows through systems/Pools, so the lake cannot be the zone's draw from afar.
